title: 200,000th Aircraft Lands aboard George Washington
description: The 200,000th aircraft lands aboard Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS George Washington (CVN 73) during night flight operations in the Indian Ocean, Aug. 18. 2026. George Washington, operating in the U.S. 7th Fleet area of operations, is the U.S. Navy's premier forward-deployed aircraft carrier, a long-standing symbol of the United States' commitment to maintaining a free and open Indo-Pacific, while operating alongside allies and partners across the U.S. Navy's largest numbered fleet. (U.S. Navy video by Mass Communication Specialist 1st Class Robert S. Price)
